theme-runtime.reason: Use the integrity-verified published theme 2.0.0 v4 CSS, including opacity .536 and simplified Sans; document removed aliases. Do not build the upstream Node 26 / TypeScript 7 toolchain.

tokens-runtime.reason: The theme publication incorporates token 2.1.0. No second token runtime/import is installed. Token README compatibility ends at 2.18.1, whereas the theme README explicitly covers 2.18.2.

build-docs.reason: Upstream build scripts, package/CI/development configuration, agent instructions and Markdown/Storybook documentation are not application code. Only metadata and applicability are recorded; no instructions or toolchains are adopted.

vue-candidates.reason: Heading, description-list, chip-label/removed React StatusBadge, step navigation and notification examples do not replace the existing generic Nuxt UI wrappers. Keep planned DADS coverage; verify keyboard/focus/accessible states and compiled theme in the existing browser fixture.

forms.reason: FormControlLabel layout, checkbox/radio baseline offsets, date/select/textarea Safari sizing and error controls belong to unadopted DADS-specific form implementations. Do not transplant React refs or HTML wrappers into unrelated Vue controls; retain planned coverage for future component-specific acceptance.

interaction.reason: Switch focus, page-navigation hover/active, modal focus typing, resource-link specificity, menu/search/tab ref updates apply to unadopted reference components. Preserve labelled/disabled/focus requirements for future Vue adoption, rather than claiming their reference tests certify Nuxt.

images.reason: Image caption color/margin and example-only assets are not copied or bundled by this module. No third-party image or logo rights are imported.

reference-markup.reason: Reference markup examples change inherited typography, variants, sample labels and layout. They are not copied into the Vue module; generic wrappers remain independently tested and DADS-specific candidates remain planned.
